stem.text: A block is in equilibrium on a slope.

stem.alt: Diagram of a slope rising to the right, with a block on its upper surface labelled block. A dashed horizontal line is drawn beneath the slope.

stem.text: Which vector triangle represents the three forces acting on the block?

A.alt: Closed triangle of three straight arrows. The top side arrow points left, the sloping side arrow points up and the vertical side arrow points down.

B.alt: Closed triangle of three straight arrows. The top side arrow points left, the sloping side arrow points down and the vertical side arrow points down.

C.alt: Closed triangle of three straight arrows. The top side arrow points right, the sloping side arrow points up and the vertical side arrow points down.

D.alt: Closed triangle of three straight arrows. The top side arrow points right, the sloping side arrow points up and the vertical side arrow points up.
